Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

Version 1.9.4

  • Adapted convertToEGRET to the updated EGRET::populateDaily(), which now returns one row per day. The EGRET Daily frame is now keyed on Date (the internal dateTime column was removed), convertToEGRETDaily() and expandFlowForEGRET() reject sub-daily flow data with an informative error, and the sample flow path computes an instantaneous Q per observation rather than routing through populateDaily(). Date conversions use each series’ own timezone for consistent Date keys.

  • Fixed inconsistent prediction column naming for loadLm: predictSolute() now names the prediction column conc or flux to match the other load models, rather than fit (#258).

Developed by Alison P. Appling, Miguel C. Leon.
